```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7)
```

RiboLace data has been preprocessed following the recommended protocol, including: read trimming, rRNA/tRNA/snRNA contaminant removal, STAR genome/transcriptome alignment, and UMI-based deduplication.

Implements the riboWaltz package for P-site identification and QC

+ https://github.com/LabTranslationalArchitectomics/riboWaltz
+ https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1006169

For downstream analysis, the ribosome P-site must be identified in each ribosome protected fragment (RPF = read). 

```{r get params}
library(riboWaltz)
library(data.table)

bam_file <- params$bam
gtf_file <- params$gtf
transcript_fasta <- params$transcript_fasta
cds_coverage_out <- params$cds_coverage_out

if (is.null(bam_file) || is.null(gtf_file) ||
    is.null(transcript_fasta) || is.null(cds_coverage_out) ||
    !nzchar(bam_file) || !nzchar(gtf_file) || !nzchar(transcript_fasta) || !nzchar(cds_coverage_out)) {
  stop("Missing required params: bam, gtf, transcript_fasta, cds_coverage_out", call. = FALSE)
}

if (!file.exists(bam_file)) {
  stop(paste("BAM file not found:", bam_file), call. = FALSE)
}

if (!file.exists(gtf_file)) {
  stop(paste("GTF file not found:", gtf_file), call. = FALSE)
}

if (!file.exists(transcript_fasta)) {
  stop(paste("Transcript FASTA not found:", transcript_fasta), call. = FALSE)
}

sample_name <- sub(".dedup.transcriptome.bam$", "", basename(bam_file))
```

# Load transcriptome

Creates a transcript annotation table with UTR and CDS lengths from the input GTF (i.e., riboWaltz::create_annotation() with updated package requirements)

```{r create annotation}
make_ribowaltz_annotation <- function(gtf_path) {
  # Build TxDb from GTF
  txdb <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF(
    file = gtf_path,
    format = "gtf"
  )

  # Extract transcript parts
  exon <- GenomicFeatures::exonsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)
  utr5 <- GenomicFeatures::fiveUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)
  cds  <- GenomicFeatures::cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)
  utr3 <- GenomicFeatures::threeUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)

  # Convert to data.table
  exon_dt <- as.data.table(exon[unique(names(exon))])
  utr5_dt <- as.data.table(utr5[unique(names(utr5))])
  cds_dt  <- as.data.table(cds[unique(names(cds))])
  utr3_dt <- as.data.table(utr3[unique(names(utr3))])

  # Summarize lengths per transcript
  anno_df <- exon_dt[, list(l_tr = sum(width)), by = list(transcript = group_name)]
  l_utr5 <- utr5_dt[, list(l_utr5 = sum(width)), by = list(transcript = group_name)]
  l_cds <- cds_dt[, list(l_cds = sum(width)), by = list(transcript = group_name)]
  l_utr3 <- utr3_dt[, list(l_utr3 = sum(width)), by = list(transcript = group_name)]
  
  merge_allx <- function(x, y) merge(x, y, all.x=TRUE)
  anno_df  <-  Reduce(merge_allx, list(anno_df, l_utr5, l_cds, l_utr3))
  anno_df[is.na(anno_df)] <- 0
  
  return(anno_df)
}

annotation_dt <- make_ribowaltz_annotation(gtf_file)
```

# Load preprocessed RiboLace reads

Creates a per-read table from the input transcriptome-aligned bam and transcript annotation table. Includes: transcript ID, CDS position, andread position in transcript.

```{r read bam}
reads_list <- bamtolist(
  bamfolder = dirname(bam_file),
  annotation = annotation_dt,
  transcript_align = TRUE,
  name_samples = setNames(sample_name,sub(".bam$", "", basename(bam_file)))
)

if (!length(reads_list)) {
  stop("bamtolist returned no samples", call. = FALSE)
}
```

# Read length filtering

Plots read length. Eukaryotic ribosomes usually cover 28nt.

```{r plot read length}
length_dist <- rlength_distr(reads_list, sample = sample_name, colour = "#333f50")
length_dist[[paste0("plot_", sample_name)]]
```

Plots the abundance of read 5’/3’ ends mapped around the start and stop codons of annotated CDSs, stratified by length. Limited to 95% of reads. 

```{r plot read extremities}
ends_heatmap <- rends_heat(reads_list, annotation_dt,
                           sample = sample_name, cl = 95,
                           colour = "#333f50")
ends_heatmap[[paste0("plot_", sample_name)]]
```

Filters reads to read lengths that satisfy a periodicity threshold. For a given read length, >50% of read ends fall must within one reading frame in the CDS.

```{r filter periodicity}
filtered_list <- length_filter(data = reads_list, sample = sample_name,
                               length_filter_mode = "periodicity",
                               periodicity_threshold = 50)
```

# P-site identification

Calculates P-site offsets per read length and adds P-site position to each read. 

+ P-site offset (PO): distance from the 5' and 3' read ends and the first nucleotide of the P-site
+ Different read lengths may represent different ribosome conformations, so a P-site offset must be calculated for each. 
+ For each read length, first identifies P-site offset when P-site is an annotated start codon, then calculates the P-site offset.
+ P-site offsets are optimized across read length bins.

Outputs:

+ Per-read length table: % of reads, % of reads aligned on start codon, P-site offset before/after correction
+ Filtered per-read table: adds P-site position, distance from start/stop codon, and region (UTR or CDS)

```{r psite}
psite_offset <- psite(filtered_list, extremity = "auto")
reads_psite_list <- psite_info(filtered_list, psite_offset)
```

Calculates number of P-sites per transcript / triplet. Used for downstream translation level analysis. 

Output:

+ Per-transcript table: ID, length, number of in-frame P-sites in coding regions (e.g., translation level)
+ Per-triplet table: transcript ID, number of P-sites; includes CDS and UTRs

```{r cds coverage}
cds_coverage <- cds_coverage(reads_psite_list, annotation_dt)
codon_coverage <- codon_coverage(reads_psite_list, annotation_dt, 
                                 sample = sample_name)
```

# QC

Plots P-site location on the transcript compared to background (RNAs = random fragmentation of all transcripts). P-sites should be enriched in CDSs. 

```{r cds enrichment}
psite_per_region <- region_psite(reads_psite_list, annotation_dt,
                 sample = sample_name,
                 colour = c("#333f50", "gray70", "#39827c"))
psite_per_region[["plot"]]
```

Plots % of P-sites in each of the 3 possible reading frames for CDSs and UTRs, overall and stratified by read length. Used to confirm codon periodicity in CDS. 

```{r codon periodicity}
frames <- frame_psite(reads_psite_list, annotation_dt,
                       sample = sample_name,
                       region = "all",
                       colour = c("#333f50", "#39827c"))
frames[[paste0("plot_",sample_name)]]
 
frames_stratified <- frame_psite_length(reads_psite_list, annotation_dt,
                                         sample = sample_name,
                                         region = "all",
                                         colour = "#333f50")
frames_stratified[[paste0("plot_",sample_name)]]
```

Plots the abundance of P-sites around CDS stop and start codons. Used to confirm trinucleotide periodicity along coding sequences.

```{r trinucleotide periodicity}
metaprofile <- metaprofile_psite(reads_psite_list, annotation_dt,
                 sample = sample_name,
                 colour = "#333f50")
metaprofile[[paste0("plot_", sample_name)]]
```

Plots the codon usage frequency for in-frame P-sites along CDSs, normalized by overall codon frequency in CDSs.

```{r codon usage}
cu_barplot <- codon_usage_psite(
  reads_psite_list,
  annotation_dt,
  sample = sample_name,
  fastapath = transcript_fasta,
  fasta_genome = FALSE,
  refseq_sep = "|"
)
cu_barplot[[paste0("plot_", sample_name)]]
```

Write per-transcript coverage table

```{r write cds coverage}
write.table(
  cds_coverage,
  file = cds_coverage_out,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE
)
```
